name: cloudai-scan
description: Find ungoverned AI usage in a Cloudflare account or a Workers repository: direct provider calls, exposed keys, open MCP servers, unprotected LLM endpoints, loose AI Gateway settings.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --main-fields=module,main --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
